subject: SummitCard: evidence pack request + vertical addenda feasibility
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@summitcard.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@summitcard.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: evidence pack + addenda pathing for regulated card data use

Mina —

Thanks for taking this call last week. SummitCard is heading into a pilot with a third-party payments partner and we need to validate vendor controls quickly. Procurement asked me to send a short list of asks so your security/compliance team can confirm feasibility: 

- Do you have a HIPAA BAA template and a GLBA addendum? Any prior precedent with card-issuing fintechs?
- Can Redwood commit to a US-only residency for tokenized PANs and generated model outputs tied to that dataset?
- Audit log retention and access: can you provide attestation of retention period and an exportable CSV for audits?
- KMS/HSM key custodianship model for encryption-at-rest (we use AWS KMS in our environment)

Attached is our short security questionnaire (SummitCard_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). Can we get an "evidence pack" (pointers to SOC2 evidence, DLP controls, sample audit export, and a BAA/GLBA addendum draft) by EOD Tuesday? That would unblock our internal legal review.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Emily
Emily Carter
Sr. Manager, Vendor Risk & Procurement
SummitCard

[Attachment: SummitCard_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@summitcard.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence pack + addenda pathing for regulated card data use

Emily —

Thanks for the questionnaire and the clear asks. Looping in Karthik (privacy/legal) and Vanessa (product/ops) so we can assemble a focused package. High-level answers up front: 

- We maintain a BAA template and can scope a GLBA addendum for financial services customers; we have precedent with several neobanks (redacted).
- US-only residency for token-related data is generally feasible when customers opt into Private deployment or Dedicated with residency controls; for Hosted API we can provide region routing + onshore subprocessor commitments as an alternative.
- Audit logs: we can provide exportable logs and an attestation; retention windows are configurable (30/90/365 days common patterns).
- KMS: we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) in Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we offer envelope encryption with customer-managed keys for enterprise plans.

We will prepare: 1) an evidence pack PDF with SOC2 pointers & screenshots, 2) an annotated BAA + GLBA addendum draft highlighting any non-standard clauses, and 3) a technical ops checklist for residency/KMS. Target EOD Tuesday (2026-08-11). If Procurement needs a faster stub we can send an interim pack tomorrow morning.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Manager, Regulatory & Privacy
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_evidence_pack_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@summitcard.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence pack + addenda pathing for regulated card data use

Emily / team —

Quick clarifications from legal: 
- GLBA: our standard addendum assumes no persistent storage of raw PANs unless the customer explicitly provisions Dedicated/Private and signs the GLBA addendum. We can include specific processing limitations in the addendum (tokenization flow + purge timelines).
- BAA: we can provide a redline-friendly BAA draft. A couple of items procurement typically redlines: data portability / return-and-delete timing, subcontractor restrictions, and breach notification SLA. We will flag any clauses that require escalated sign-off (e.g., vendor indemnity caps).

Soojin — can you confirm whether ops can evidence a 365-day retention option for audit logs and an export sample? Vanessa — any constraints on offering a US-only residency path in Hosted for this customer if they want to stay with Hosted (we may need to propose Dedicated as the default)?

Karthik

>

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@summitcard.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence pack + addenda pathing for regulated card data use

Emily / all —

Confirmed from ops: we can provide an exportable CSV audit bundle that includes request id, model id, requester IP (redacted on request), timestamp, and processing node id. Retention options we can offer out of the box: 30 / 90 / 365 days. For a 365-day export we will need a standard SLA and likely Dedicated capacity if sustained throughput is high.

Residency: Hosted routing can be constrained to US regions, but we do not currently guarantee a single-tenant US-only Hosted instance. Dedicated or Private is the supported path for a true US-only residency guarantee. Technically we can propose an onshore fallback routing + contractual subprocessor residency commitments for Hosted; will call this out in the addendum.

Attaching the preliminary evidence pack and an annotated BAA/GLBA draft. Notes inside the BAA draft call out indemnity items and breach SLA windows that procurement usually asks to revise.

Soojin
Principal Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_evidence_pack_v1.pdf, BAA-draft-annotated.docx]

If possible we would like the sample CSV and a short answer on BYOK by EOD Thursday. VendorSec — can you propose 2 slots for the observational test tomorrow?

Emily
